text:
erin (procurement): heads-up: Vendor ARC just flagged a firmware lot. 7 H200s on PO-83421 moved to 'RMA-park' at origin, ETA extended 5w -> 9w.
tom (supply-ops): rough hit to EU dedicated pool?
leah (eng-infra): about 12% batch throughput loss during nightly jobs. increases queue and retry churn.
ben (logistics): if split shipments needed we'll incur extra AWB and customs entries. estimate ~€260 per split.
olga (vendor_arc): confirm: 7 units flagged after bench QA. we can release 3 'clean' units in 10 days for expedited fee or send 4 loaners today (refurb). expedited add-on: +10% freight + $420/unit test.
erin (procurement): what's ARC willing to do on credits if we accept delay?
olga (vendor_arc): offer 6% invoice credit on delayed units, or 9% if you commit to a 3-month follow-on allocation. waive test fee on first 2 expedited units if you sign addendum.
tom (supply-ops): ask for serials now so we can tag nodes and avoid surprises. also need preflight logs for customs pre-clear.
ben (logistics): loaners -> refurbished customs paperwork required, longer clearance risk. DAP preferred, tell vendor to include EORI & refurb declaration.
leah (eng-infra): can we gate any suspect firmware behind a feature flag? if it's a non-critical regression maybe deploy behind flag and mitigate impact.
olga (vendor_arc): we'll provide serial list + firmware diff + test vectors by EOD. can sign off faster if deployed behind agreed mitigation.
erin (procurement): proposal: take 3 expedited cleaned units (waived fees on first 2 per addendum) + 4 loaners for immediate capacity. negotiate 9% credit on delayed tranche if we sign follow-on commit.
tom (supply-ops): I support. request addendum include serial delivery timeline and waived test fees.
ben (logistics): once serials in i'll book DAP courier and prepare split AWBs; need pre-clear docs to reduce inspection risk.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-8999 - "Vendor ARC H200 RMA-park partial release + loaner coordination". Assignees: ben, tom, erin. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-8999
erin (procurement): next steps: 1) olga sends serials + logs; 2) legal drafts addendum for 9% credit + waived fees; 3) ben books courier on receipt; 4) leah validates risk of feature-flag deployment. i'll loop in finance.
olga (vendor_arc): will send docs and cc legal@vendor-arc.com. thanks all.
tom (supply-ops): :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled in 72h for INF-8999 follow-up.
